collection.description: A deep rumble beneath the island alarms the villagers.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A deep rumble is heard beneath the island, alarming villagers.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: One villager believes they can learn to sense the tremors.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Another points to moving earth and trapped gases.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A spiritual leader invites reflection without predicting doom.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: Observers compare tremor frequency and ground changes.

r1.name: Resolution 1
r1.text: The villager discovers a plausible ordinary cause but may still value the experience for personal reasons.

r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
